definitions.explanation: The brain as a physical organ, in casual speech.
One's ability to think, in casual and often teasing or rude remarks.

examples.japanese: {脳|のう}みそ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}け→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧そうな⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧だ。
examples.english: It's hot enough to melt your brain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脳|のう}みそ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧1.3⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Apparently the human brain weighs about 1.3 kilograms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}→頭蓋骨：33418_zugaikotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{脳|のう}みそ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れて→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: If you hit your head hard, your brain gets shaken inside your skull, which is dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{脳|のう}みそ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}え→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{脳|のう}みそ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I got angry when someone said I didn't have enough brains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧{脳|のう}みそ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}かない→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{続|つづ}き→続き：03526_tsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so tired my brain won't work, so let's continue tomorrow.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written {脳味噌|のうみそ}.

WATCH OUT:
Casual. Said of someone else, as in {脳|のう}みそ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧, it is an insult. In medical and neutral talk the brain is ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧: the brain, the neutral and medical word
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧: the everyday word for intelligence (⟦{頭|あたま}がいい→頭がいい：20316_atamagaii⟧)
- ⟦{頭脳|ずのう}→頭脳：00438_zunou⟧: brains, intellect (formal: ⟦{頭脳|ずのう}→頭脳：00438_zunou⟧⟦{明晰|めいせき}→明晰：10672_meiseki⟧)
